HTTP Markdown excludes hidden elements and template text by default while preserving visible text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Crawlberg\Crawlberg;
use Crawlberg\CrawlConfig;
$engine_config = CrawlConfig::from_json(json_encode(["browser" => ["mode" => "never"], "content" => ["extractMetadata" => false]]));
$engine = Crawlberg::createEngine($engine_config);
$url = "https://example.com";
$result = Crawlberg::scrape($engine, $url);
var_dump($result->statusCode);
var_dump($result->getMarkdown()?->content);
```
